WEB_GEOMETRY_PERSONALIZED.note: Numeric personalization is real (stage2=f(stage1)=f(photo); same person 0.74mm vs different person 2.44-3.29mm) BUT PC A/B/C render verdict (2026-09-10): geometry injection is a VISUAL REGRESSION vs neutral head + bake. Root cause: bake texture is painted for the NEUTRAL mesh; warping geometry without re-baking misaligns painted features (bulging ring-eyes, sagging jaw). stage2c MESH_DIR turned out to be DEAD CODE (mv/mkpt loaded, never used) - the personalization always flowed through stage1 anchors. Jaw/chin anchors have known semantic offset (stage1 header says so; stage2c TPS wrongly used them -> fixed to rigid_core in chain_geometry). Even with rigid_core the warp shifts the whole face ~2cm (cm-scale anchor mapping noise). DECISION: V1 default = TEXTURE-ONLY (golden, device-proven); geometry = explicit experimental opt-in (geometry=on, UI checkbox) pending texture-re-bake-on-warped-mesh (V2).

FACE_SLOT_MAPPING.note: b1 10-15 -> face_eastAsia_new1-6 (slot = b1 - 9), device-proven with 6-player tinted probe (B10=red/new1, B11=green/new2, B12=blue/new3, B13=yellow/new4, B14=rose/new5, B15=dark-green/new6). Applies to DEFAULT-HEAD (fa/fb/fc=0) players. Real-head players (cloned fa/fb/fc) use the head asset's own material slot (golden MJ pipeline injected new1 with b1=14 clones and it displayed). ROOT CAUSE OF 'all faces identical / not like photo': earlier origin builds had b1=14 -> device read slot new5 (untouched baseline) while bakes were injected into new1 - the bake was NEVER displayed.

PER_PLAYER_SLOTS.note: inject_player_v1 auto-allocates lowest free b1 in 10-15 from registry (face_texture_id=0 = auto); texture_inject/mesh_inject take slot_b1 and target face_eastAsia_new{b1-9} (men path); app.py auto-registers pid/jersey/slot on BUILD PASS. Demo built: PhotoA(175932,jersey21,slot new1,golden-tight bake) + PhotoB(175933,jersey22,slot new2,candidate-c2 bake), both with MediaPipe skeleton. Install pending device re-connect.
PER_PLAYER_SLOTS.limit: 6 distinct faces per APK (b1 10-15); mesh asset face_EastAsia_new1 is SHARED - all default-head players get the same warped shape (per-player meshes need per-player head assets = V3).

PHOTO_DRIVEN_SKELETON.note: geowarp_mp.py: MediaPipe 468 3D landmarks -> 13-anchor 3D Umeyama -> dense per-vertex displacement on the EA1 700-vert template (533/700 verts active, mean 2.71mm max 6.98mm), confidence mask + clamp 8mm + Laplacian smooth. Replaces MICA-mesh registration (unreliable: eye sockets 17mm, cheeks 108mm NN mismatch). Face shape now comes entirely from the user's photo.

cache_semantics: preview cache key = sha256(bake bytes [+ stage2 bytes]). Same photo re-upload => byte-identical bakes/geometry => INSTANT cache hits (user's repeated same-photo uploads on 09-09 evening were all cache hits - this, not a broken chain, is why 'every photo returns the same model' during those tests; different photos DO produce different cards).
